text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Everybody ready?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, here we go... Let's party hard at
Bubblyland!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait, why are we in swimsuits?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Because this is a pool resort, of course. ♪
They let you enter the
disco and cafes in
your swimsuit here! Plus, you feel the vibes
more!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Tickezo, are you sure you don't want to
buy a swimsuit?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Our school-issue swimsuit is durable!
It's perfect for swimming as
hard as you
can, so it's good enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If you say so! Now come on! Let's enjoy
ourselves to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-wh-what should I do? There's no way
I can get any training done
here!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(In fact, I don't see training grounds
anywhere, and all the visitors just
look like
they're here to have fun...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(What did Maruzen even mean when she
said I could get out of my
slump here?)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You know, Spe... There's only one thing
you should be doing here
today, and it's
not running.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's... not? Then what is it...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Dancing?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Spe! Let's go up on that platform
and get our groove on!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Uh, you want to go over to that...
dance stage thing? I don't
know. I'm just,
uh, I don't know what to do on one!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! Once you start dancing, none
of that'll matter! It'll be
fun!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Maruzen said she wanted you to
have fun and enjoy yourself
to the max
today, so let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Spe! Just humor me and come
dance with us! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! W-wait a second!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! What should I do?! I don't know
how this dance goes at all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! This isn't a concert, so don't worry
about choreography or
anything! It'll be
fine—just dance your heart out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: D-dance my heart out?! U-umm, like this?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! Just like that! Don't forget to
cheer too! Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-wooooo?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, wave that fan! One, two! One, two!
That's the spirit! Looking
good, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
O-one, two. One, two... Hehe. Just what
are we doing? Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, thanks, Tickezo. You two are
looking fine! ♪

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Maruzensky's here!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my, my! Are you having fun, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Visitors
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's all lose ourselves to the magic of the
disco! Woohoo!

The excitement reaches new heights as the
entire venue goes wild to
Maruzensky's
call!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(People are smiling, music's playing, and
everything's so bright and
sparkly! It feels
like a dream!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (What is this feeling? It's been such a long time since I've felt this way...)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Spe! Don't forget to wave your fan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay! Ehehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Nata de coco's the best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, have you guys gone down that
waterslide yet? It's so fast and
super fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's huge! Just listen to those
screams, though. Is it really safe?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look over there! Another dance podium!
It's called a water disco,
'cause you can
dance surrounded by water fountains!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! So many girls are dancing on it! It
looks like lots of fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This park is filled to the brim with
delicious food and fun things to
do... I
never knew such a place existed.
Ding, dong....

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's happy hour at Bubbly Cafe, where you
can enjoy our
all-you-can-eat tiramisu.
Come and join us!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All-you-can-eat tiramisu?! No way! Oh my
gosh, where's the cafe?!
